entities.summary: Eduard Heinrich Flottwell was a Prussian Staatsminister. He served as Oberpräsident (governor) of the Grand Duchy of Posen and of the Saxony, Westphalia, Prussia (1849–1850) and Brandenburg provinces. He was also Prussian minister of finance (1844-1846) and interior minister (1858-1859).
